evidence.reason: The inventory binding decoder uses refuseQueue for its other invalid-input checks, but line 274 calls normalizeInterval directly. When normalizeInterval rejects an invalid/equal interval, its ReconcileRefused escapes decodeInventoryBinding instead of being surfaced as QueueRefused, so callers handling queue-wire refusals via QueueRefused cannot catch this case. This is a small local exception-type correction, not a new requirement.
